IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID or opaque unique value per intended operation. Retain for at least24h; same key plus changed body returns409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted version ETag from GET; missing returns428, mismatch412.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque stable continuation token bound to original filters.

Money.description: Non-negative IDR decimal string; at most two fractional digits. Amount-changing commands require a strictly positive value unless stated otherwise.

TransactionCreate.description: Allocation amounts must sum to amount exactly. Optional person_shares total10000 basis points and are applied using largest remainder in minor units. The combination with multiple categories is supported only through an explicit reviewed matrix; otherwise return422 SPLIT_MODE_CONFLICT.

AssetTradeCreate.description: Buy/sell require positive quantity and gross_amount; wallet required except pre-owned opening. Dividend requires gross_amount and wallet. Correction requires target_quantity and reason, preserves cost basis. Server locks holding; sale cannot exceed owned units.

CalendarFeed.description: url_once returned only on creation/rotation. Never log or export it. Deleting revokes access.
